items.title: ✏️ You can edit the tracker prompt
items.body: Your most-requested feature. You can now see and change the full set of instructions DES sends the AI to fill in your trackers — all of it, including the part that used to be locked. Find it in Prompts Editor → Tracker Prompt. Change whatever you like and the AI gets exactly your version. Leave it alone and it keeps updating itself as you add new fields. It shows roughly how many tokens it costs, there's a Restore Default button if you want to start over, and DES warns you if an edit would leave one of your panels with nothing to show.

items.title: 🧩 Custom tracker fields can have a type
items.body: When you add your own field to the Scene Tracker, you can now choose what kind of answer you want back: text, a number (with a range if you like), a choice from a list you write, a list, yes/no, or a percentage. The AI is told exactly what to give you, so you get tidy, usable answers instead of whatever it felt like writing. Your custom fields also now appear as on/off switches in Settings → Scene Tracker — before, they never showed up there. Fields you already have keep working exactly as they did.

items.title: 🛠️ New Workshop section in Settings
items.body: Relationships have their own home now: Settings → Workshop. Add your own (Sworn Rival, anyone?), rename or remove them, and pick each one's emoji by clicking from a grid instead of hunting for it on your keyboard. You can switch relationship tracking off entirely if you don't use it. There's also a new box to tell the AI what a relationship actually means — say, 'how this character feels about me' — with a preview showing exactly what gets sent.

items.title: 🎭 Your relationships show up on character cards
items.body: In the Character Workshop, the 'Relationship to player' row only ever showed the original five choices, so any you'd added couldn't be picked there. Now your own relationships appear too, at the end of the row. It stays one tidy line no matter how many you have — use the arrows on either side to scroll through them.

items.title: 🪟 A roomier Edit Trackers window
items.body: The Edit Trackers window used to squeeze everything into a narrow column. It's now much bigger, split into clearly labelled sections, and still works on a phone. Its text boxes finally match your theme instead of glaring bright white on dark themes. The Widgets section is gone — several of its switches didn't actually do anything, and the rest now live in Settings → Scene Tracker.

items.title: 🕐 The Scene Tracker stays put
items.body: Fixed the Scene Tracker seeming to vanish until you turned it off and on again. It was really getting stuck to an older message and scrolling out of sight whenever the scene hadn't changed between turns. It now always follows the newest message.

items.title: 💬 Chat bubble text wraps around the portrait
items.body: Long messages in chat bubbles no longer leave a big empty gap under the character's portrait. The text now flows around the picture and fills the full width once it's past it. Works in both the Discord and Card styles.

items.title: 📱 Two phone fixes
items.body: The mobile typing screen no longer pops open on its own when you reload the page, finish sending, or close a popup — only when you actually tap the message box. And the 'Is this the same character?' popup no longer slides off the top of the screen with only its bottom half showing.
